system.description:
Psionics: Fortress · cast at S-Rank · no type

+1 AC (+2 against Genjutsu attacks).

A creature that hits you with a melee weapon or Taijutsu attack makes an Intelligence save: on a failure it falls Prone and drops its weapon; on a critical failure its speed is also 0 until the end of its next turn. It also takes 4d6 psychic damage (8d6 on a critical failure).

10 DR against psychic damage.
